title: Spatial Context or Memory? Sizing the Inputs of Neural Surrogates for Partially Observed Fields
abstract: arXiv:2610.12723v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural surrogates that forecast a physical field from sparse, noisy sensors read a window of nearby sensors and a history of past snapshots. Practitioners choose both by comparing fitted models with each other. Such comparisons cannot tell a model's shortfall from missing information. We measure the trade-off between window and history against the Bayes-optimal error of the same readings. An exact Gaussian analysis shows that noisy or sparse observation of a field with local dynamics makes the optimal forecast read distant sensors only through spatial correlation. On a forced linear field with a known optimum, trained models that read only the window come within 1% of it. We then train such models on viscous Burgers flow and the chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation, with every deciding comparison fixed before any test evaluation. translated_title: 空间上下文还是记忆？确定部分观测场神经代理模型的输入规模
translated_abstract: 从稀疏、含噪传感器预测物理场的神经代理模型会读取一个邻近传感器窗口和一段过去快照的历史。实践者通常通过相互比较拟合好的模型来选择这两者，但这种比较无法将模型自身的不足与信息的缺失区分开来。我们以相同读数下的贝叶斯最优误差为基准来衡量窗口与历史之间的权衡。精确的高斯分析表明，对于具有局部动力学的场，含噪或稀疏的观测使得最优预测只能通过空间相关性来读取远处的传感器。在一个具有已知最优解的受迫线性场上，仅读取窗口的训练模型即可达到与最优解相差1%以内的水平。随后，我们在粘性Burgers流和混沌的Kuramoto-Sivashinsky（KS）方程上训练此类模型，且所有决定性比较均在任何测试评估之前予以固定。在除KS之外的所有场中，八张快照所消除的单快照误差比例随窗口长度增加而下降（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文以贝叶斯最优误差为基准，首次精确量化了部分观测场神经代理模型中空间传感器窗口与历史快照长度之间的权衡，证明对于具有局部动力学的稀疏含噪观测场，扩大空间窗口比增加记忆更有效，且仅读取空间窗口的模型即可接近最优预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks the trade-off between spatial sensor windows and history length in neural surrogates for partially observed fields against the Bayes-optimal error, showing that for sparsely, noisily observed fields with local dynamics, widening the spatial window matters more than adding memory, with window-only models coming within 1% of the optimum.
